headline: Apple confirms Siri will be the same everywhere across all devices
summary: Apple's goal for its AI assistant is a consistent experience, regardless of the device you're using.
details: Apple has confirmed a key AI upgrade for Siri: the assistant will now offer a consistent experience across all its devices.
This means users can expect the same functionality and interaction, whether they are using Siri on an iPhone, iPad, Mac, or Apple Watch.
This unified approach is a deliberate strategy by Apple to enhance user familiarity and streamline interactions with their ecosystem.

headline_marked: NTS Radio Player [[brings internet radio to hi-fi]] for $179
headline: NTS Radio Player brings internet radio to hi-fi for $179
summary: The $179 NTS Radio Player offers 24-bit/192kHz audio and connects to any stereo, also supporting popular streaming services via AirPlay 2, Google Cast, and more.
details: NTS Radio has partnered with Swedish audio company Atonemo to create a dedicated player that bridges internet radio to traditional hi-fi systems. This device allows users to stream NTS's curated mixes and stations directly to their existing stereo or speaker setups.

Priced at $179, the NTS Radio Player supports high-fidelity 24-bit/192kHz audio output through a standard 3.5mm jack. It includes an adapter cable for easy connection to vintage hi-fi systems or other audio equipment with RCA inputs.

The player features dedicated buttons for direct access to NTS 1 and NTS 2, along with a large dial for navigating the station's extensive library of infinite mixtapes. Beyond NTS content, it also supports popular streaming services like Qobuz and Apple Music via AirPlay 2, Google Cast, Spotify Connect, or Tidal Connect.

NTS Radio, established in 2011, is renowned for its human-curated music discovery, offering a diverse range of genres from obscure psychedelia to deep house. Unlike algorithm-driven platforms, NTS relies on passionate DJs and guest hosts to select its programming, ensuring a unique listening experience.
